dct_description_sm: Juvenile and adult marine fish are collected to be characterized as to age, size, condition, sex, maturity and gut content. The objective is to describe the basic biological characteristics (e.g. growth, feeding) of various marine forage fish species in the Canadian Arctic. This database is essential to assess how key forage fish (e.g. Arctic cod for marine mammals and seabirds, Greenland cod for humans) react to their changing environment.
dct_title_s: Biological data of marine Arctic fish in Franklin Bay
